hero.title: Shipping Fast, Scalable Web Products & AI Workflows.
hero.subtitle: I'm Ahmad Na'im — a fullstack product developer based in Yogyakarta helping startups and businesses launch clean UI, reliable backends, AI chatbots, and payment systems in weeks.

story.headline2: I ship production products in weeks.
story.paragraph: I combine clean interface craft with pragmatic fullstack engineering — from company profiles and operational dashboards to data-driven web apps. Every build is structured for speed, maintainability, and real conversion.
story.quote: "Good UI is obvious. Great engineering is invisible."

portfolio.title: Featured Case Studies
portfolio.subtitle: Real-world web applications, operational dashboards, and high-converting digital storefronts.
portfolio.sabanaProblem: Outdoor gear rental operations relied on manual WhatsApp chats and disconnected stock tracking.
portfolio.sabanaSolution: Built a dual-sided PWA combining a staff inventory & WA-order-extraction dashboard with a public rental catalog and booking tracker (Cek Resi).
portfolio.scholarifyProblem: Students needed an integrated SNBT tryout experience with clear post-test performance evaluation.
portfolio.scholarifySolution: Engineered a company profile and SNBT tryout platform featuring structured data analysis and score insights.
portfolio.airaProblem: Customers had to message manually just to check pricing, pickup schedules, and store locations.
portfolio.airaSolution: Created a modern digital storefront with transparent pricing, online booking flow, and pickup/delivery scheduling.

services.title: End-to-End Product Services
services.description: Everything needed to take your digital product from concept to a fast, scalable production launch.
services.webDevDesc: Fullstack websites and web applications — authentication, operational dashboards, admin panels, and APIs.
services.uiUxDesc: Modern, responsive interfaces engineered with accessibility, micro-interactions, and performance in mind.
services.backendDesc: Clean REST APIs, relational database modeling, query optimization, and maintainable architecture.
services.deploymentDesc: Cloud/Vercel deployment, environment hardening, monitoring, and ongoing post-launch support.
services.chatbotDesc: Automated 24/7 AI customer assistant integrated directly with WhatsApp, Instagram, or your website.
services.paymentDesc: Seamless Midtrans and Xendit payment integration for instant checkout and automated order tracking.

process.title: How We Ship in Weeks
process.subtitle: A transparent, sprint-driven workflow designed for founders and growing businesses.
process.step1Desc: Align on business goals, user flows, core features, and timeline in a focused kickoff.
process.step2Desc: Design clean interfaces, component systems, and database schemas before writing production code.
process.step3Desc: Iterative frontend, backend, AI, and payment integrations with regular live preview links.
process.step4Desc: Production deployment, performance checks, domain setup, and post-launch maintenance.
